en.topic_title: In Pictures: Fans pay tribute to Hong Kong independent bookshop Have a Nice Stay on final day following raid
en.topic_summary:
Dozens of bookworms squeezed into Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on Sunday for its final day in business, paying tribute to the shop that was raided by national security police last month.



Have a Nice Stay co-founder Sum Wan-wah waves to his customers on the final operating day of his independent bookshop in Prince Edward, on August 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
